print_on_demand.name: INPRNT
print_on_demand.note: Highest royalty of any print-on-demand platform. Invite-only but easy to get in. Artist-respected. Best for portfolio-quality pieces.

print_on_demand.name: Redbubble
print_on_demand.note: Easiest to get started. Stickers perform well for game-adjacent art. No approval needed — upload and sell immediately.

print_on_demand.name: Society6
print_on_demand.royalty: 10% on most products, 30% on art prints
print_on_demand.note: Better for lifestyle/home decor audiences. Less game-art focused than INPRNT.

print_on_demand.name: Teepublic
print_on_demand.royalty: Fixed per sale (£2–5 on regular, more on premium)
print_on_demand.note: T-shirts perform very well for game fan art and character designs. Lower royalty but high volume potential.

commission_platforms.name: ArtStation
commission_platforms.note: Primary portfolio + commission inquiry platform. Visibility here = industry credibility.

commission_platforms.name: Ko-fi
commission_platforms.note: Zero platform fee for commissions (Ko-fi takes 0% on donations, 5% on shops). Great for emotes and simple commissions.

commission_platforms.name: Gumroad
commission_platforms.note: Best platform for selling digital products — brush packs, process PDFs, tutorial videos. Your coach notes alone could become a product.

commission_platforms.name: Fiverr
commission_platforms.note: High competition but large buyer base. Emotes and Twitch assets do well. Start at £40–60/emote, raise as you get reviews.

streaming_and_game_art.name: Twitch/Discord Emote Market
streaming_and_game_art.note: Strong demand. Streamers need emotes constantly. Get a few done, post them, and inquiries come. Quality and fast turnaround are the differentiators.

streaming_and_game_art.name: itch.io
streaming_and_game_art.note: Sell art asset packs or use it to find indie game devs who need concept artists. Active community of solo devs with budgets.

character_design.immediate_move: Post to ArtStation with full project description. Add to commission portfolio. If the face is expressive, consider a sticker on Redbubble.

prop_artifact.immediate_move: Add to ArtStation. DM 2–3 indie devs on Twitter/itch.io who are actively looking for art. This type of piece gets you game commissions.

environment_scene.immediate_move: Upload to ArtStation at full resolution. Environments get the most saves and shares. Tag #environmentdesign #conceptart.

sketch_traditional.immediate_move: Post to Instagram/TikTok as-is with #dailysketch. Raw sketch content gets strong organic reach. Then develop the best one digitally.

portrait.immediate_move: If it's a fan art portrait, post with the character's game/show tag for algorithm boost. If original character, add to commission portfolio.

creature_design.immediate_move: Creature design is a specialist skill that studios explicitly look for. Post to ArtStation with a breakdown of the design logic — this is hireable content.

meme_illustration.immediate_move: Post immediately — meme content has a short shelf life. Redbubble sticker if the design is clean enough. Use it to funnel followers to your serious art.

texture_material_study.immediate_move: Post as a study with educational framing (#artitips, #conceptarttips). This type of content gets saves and positions you as knowledgeable. Could bundle 10 studies as a Gumroad PDF.

passive_income_builds.note: Once you have a distinctive digital style, package your brushes. Artists who publish brushes build an audience fast.
Document your 5-step process as a PDF with your own artwork as examples. Beginners buy these. 100 sales = £800–2000.
Set it up once, earn passively. Every polished piece you post can go straight into the shop.
Build toward this once you have 500+ engaged followers. Offer WIPs, brushes, early access, sketchbook scans.

passive_income_builds.price: £40–60 per custom, or £15–25 for pre-made packs
passive_income_builds.note: Pre-made emote packs (generic emotions for any streamer) sell well as digital downloads. Make once, sell many.
